sla_summary: Customer requests 99.98% uptime for critical endpoints; Redwood counter: 99.95% for dedicated cluster with 4hr credit window and escalating credits: 5% ARR credit at 99.9, 10% at 99.7, additional negotiation for 99.98. Maintenance: proposed monthly 2-hour window in off-peak with 72h SLA notice; customer demands blackout on freight-sync windows (06:00-10:00 local). Support: P1 1hr response / P2 4hr / P3 24hr; customer pushing for on-call phone escalation for P1 and 30-minute initial acknowledgement.
